title: The Survivors
author: rithythul
publicationNote: Working title · Publication date to come
summary: Cambodia's startup movement since the beginning: the ups and downs, and what works and what does not.
homeNote: Some mentors never knew they were teaching.
description: Since the beginning, smallworld has been part of Cambodia's startup movement, building startups first-hand and watching others from the sidelines.
The movement has had its ups and downs, and founders who started and failed, who go unnamed here.
The book is about what works and what does not, told through the people and the things built, with the lessons from the experiments and from the mentors, whether they know it or not.
